description: Two managers: the Python project (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions. Each update waits 14 days after its release.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: uv here has no exclude-newer, so a refresh would take releases published hours earlier. Per-package updates carry the 14-day wait and move uv.lock themselves.

packageRules.description: A library declares the lowest versions it supports, and CI tests those floors (the lowest job). Raising a floor is a deliberate change, so Renovate moves uv.lock only and leaves pyproject.toml's ranges alone.
